HANDSHAKE_ONLY.description: FastMCP initialize + tools/list completed; no tool call executed.

LOCAL_MCP_RESULT_ATTESTED.description: Actual in-process client.callTool receipt verified (SHA-256, advertiser ID/domain, creative ID), but payload lacks direct Google Transparency RPC envelope metadata.

UPSTREAM_GOOGLE_RPC_ATTESTED.description: Actual in-process client.callTool receipt verified AND raw payload contains verifiable Google Transparency RPC metadata (GetAdvertiserById / SearchCreatives + AR... + CR...).

adversarialVerificationCases.scenario: FastMCP protocol handshake + tools/list without callTool
Crafted creative carrying fake googleMcpInvocationId not in private invocation ledger
Invocation receipt from advertiser A reused on creative claiming advertiser B or domain B
Synthetic MCP server returning JSON without upstream Google RPC metadata vs with RPC metadata
adversarialVerificationCases.verifiedBehavior: Without RPC metadata: provenanceTier=LOCAL_MCP_RESULT_ATTESTED, providerVerified=false, localMcpToolResultVerified=true; With RPC metadata: provenanceTier=UPSTREAM_GOOGLE_RPC_ATTESTED, providerVerified=true, upstreamRequestVerified=true

adversarialVerificationCases.scenario: Creative with creativeId + advertiserId + US region but destinationUrl=null and no explicit productId
adversarialVerificationCases.verifiedBehavior: productRelevance=UNKNOWN, pdpVerified=false, observations count=0, advertiserObservations count=1

providerInvocations attached; reconciledCounts tracks rawCreativesCount >= normalizedCount >= usVerifiedCount >= pdpBoundCount >= candidateAttributableCount
